claim: On November 17, 2022 the AppFlow documentation history added that Amazon AppFlow now reports metrics to Amazon CloudWatch, which you can monitor to learn how your flows are performing.
question: Since when does AppFlow report CloudWatch metrics?

qualifiers.scope: Amazon AppFlow metrics in Amazon CloudWatch

note: d033. The What's New feed dates the launch 2022-11-18; the history row says November 17, 2022.
